{"metadata":{"description":"Apple Liquid Glass theme for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1343948786","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-theme-liquid-glass","slug":"FAVKTOXIC/dsh-theme-liquid-glass","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Apple Liquid Glass theme for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Liquid Glass — a theme for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**简体中文** · README.zh.md"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A frosted-glass rewrite of the DeepSeek Harness interface: real SVG edge
refraction on the controls "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"you touch, a wallpaper you choose, and a session bar
that shares the window's own title bar instead "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"of stealing a row of its own."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> ### 🤖 Written end-to-end by an agent
>
> Every line of this plugin — the client bundle, the deskto"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"p chrome work, the smoke
> tests and these docs — was written **autonomously by the DeepSeek V4.1 Fl"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ash agent
> running inside the DeepSeek Harness desktop app**. No human-written code.
>
> It worked "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"the whole time inside the app it was theming: reading the harness's own
> bundles to find real DOM a"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"nchors instead of guessing selectors, driving its own
> edit → build → test → typecheck loop, and ch"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"ecking each change against the bundle
> the running window was actually serving. See How this was bu"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"ng each change against the bundle
> the running window was actually serving. See How this was built."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> ## ⚠️ Please use **dark mode**
>
> This theme is designed for dark mode and it is the only mode it"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" looks right in.
> The whole point is translucent glass over your wallpaper — in **light mode** a
> "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"bright wallpaper leaves the glass washed out and the text on top of it hard to
> read.
>
> The theme"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" does darken the light-mode secondary/tertiary greys to recover some
> contrast, but that is a mitig"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ation, not a fix. **If you use light mode, expect
> readability to suffer.** Switching DSH to dark m"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"ode fixes it completely."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Desktop build"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **The session bar *is* the title bar.** DSH's own header stacks the 对话/轨迹
tabs on a second row, 76"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"px tall. This theme moves the whole bar into the 40px
system caption — same row as 应用菜单/编辑 and the w"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"indow buttons — and lays it
out as one line. **You get that vertical space back**: the transcript st"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"arts
40px from the top instead of 56px, and the tab buttons become small rounded
buttons instead of "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"oversized glass capsules.
- **A fullscreen button.** DSH's desktop build ships no fullscreen entry p"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"oint at
all — the frameless caption only has minimize/maximize/close, no F11 or
`togglefullscreen` a"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"ccelerator is registered, and the main process never calls
`setFullScreen(true)`. The theme contribu"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"tes a 28px button in the header that
requests document fullscreen and toggles back out; the icon fol"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"lows the state,
and DSH's own fullscreen-aware layout takes over from there.
- **The caption band is"},{"id":"p9s10","text":" frosted too**, top-down, exactly like the session bar —
the strip is no longer a flat translucent r"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"ectangle.
- **Panels that used to be see-through now have a background**: the choice dialog
(the pan"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"el DSH shows when it asks you to pick an option), the file preview that
appears when you hover a row"},{"id":"p9s13","text":" in the "已编辑 N 个文件" card, that card itself, and
the question/answer receipt bubble in the transcript"},{"id":"p9s14","text":". Each gets a blur plus a
glass fill at a readable opacity.
- **Readable light-mode text** (within t"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"he limits of the note above): the
secondary / tertiary / caption greys are pushed one to two shades "},{"id":"p9s16","text":"ts of the note above): the
secondary / tertiary / caption greys are pushed one to two shades darker."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### The glass itself"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **Genuine edge refraction**, not just blur. An `feDisplacementMap` filter bends
what is behind eac"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"h surface at its rim, the way thick glass does. It rides the
composer card, the send button, message"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" bubbles, the queue dock, dialogs,
menus and sidebar buttons. **Strength is a slider** — 0 turns it "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"off, 1 is a
full lens.
- **Every glass parameter is yours**: glass tint colour, tint opacity, materi"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"al
brightness, frost blur radius, edge refraction strength, and the code-block
opacity. All of it ap"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"plies live — no reload, no restart.
- **Glass-lens buttons** and the **water-drop settings icon** th"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"at replaces the
stock gear."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### The wallpaper"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **Six sources**: none, a web URL (iframe, with an optional host proxy for sites
that send `X-Frame"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"-Options`), a local HTML file, a local image, a local video,
or the **built-in animated demo wallpap"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"er** that works out of the box.
- **Independent background controls**: wallpaper blur and wallpaper "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"brightness are
separate from the card frost, so you can keep the background soft while the
glass sta"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ys crisp.
- **The demo wallpaper is tunable**: speed, blob count, colour cycling, blob blur
and opac"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"ity, plus a background wash toggle."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Everything else"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **One-row header** even on the web GUI — sidebar toggle, conversation title,
then the tabs, the "o"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"pen in…" dropdown and the right-sidebar toggle all on one
line.
- **Nothing fights your other plugin"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"s.** The model-selection list is left exactly
as DSH ships it (an earlier version restyled it, which"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" collided with other theme
plugins), and hover styling is deliberately scoped to the surfaces this t"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"heme
actually changes.
- **A dedicated settings page** — "Liquid Glass" is a top-level section besid"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"e
General / Model / Plugins, with live preview and a one-click reset.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Compatibility and deliberate choices"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Harness | `≥ 0.1.2-rc.1`, including the `0.2.x` desktop runtime |
| Surfaces | Web GUI and the des"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ktop app (same client bundle) |
| Peer packages | the five `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` packages, dec"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"lared as **optional** peers over `^0.1.2-rc.1 \|\| ^0.2.0-0` |
| Model-selection list | **left to DS"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"H.** An earlier release restyled it; other theme plugins style the same menu and the two overwrote e"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ach other, so the theme backed off |
| Hover styling | scoped to the composer, queue dock, dialogs/m"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"enus, view tabs and sidebar only — it will not restyle another plugin's controls |
| Light mode | su"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"pported, but the glass reads washed out — see the note at the top |
| DSH tooltip bug | **known harn"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"ess bug**, reproduces without this theme: hovering the send button or the context-percentage button "},{"id":"p17s9","text":"scrolled the page to the top. The theme works around it by switching `container-type` off on three c"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"omposer/transcript boxes, which costs four narrow-window layout tweaks — see CHANGELOG.md |
| Settin"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"gs storage | `localStorage` (per browser) |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Why localStorage"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The harness settings gateway exposes only hard-coded product namespaces to
browser clients, so a thi"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"rd-party namespace stays `loading` forever even when the
host half registered it. The shipped appear"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ance and skin plugins hit the same
wall and also use `localStorage`. The trade-off is that settings "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"do not follow you
between browsers."}],"truncated":true}
